task.description:
Implement PLC-01, PLC-02, PLC-03, PLC-04 (Stage 15, SHOULD) per validated design.

BRANCH: feature/WF02-plc-batch-a-20260815 (commits 8c5b3fc0, 10bd0eeb)

DESIGN ARTEFACTS:
- src/design/plc-01-process-module-catalog.md
- src/design/plc-02-catalog-publication-requires-interface.md
- src/design/plc-03-cross-version-compatibility.md
- src/design/plc-04-cross-tenant-distribution.md

IMPLEMENTATION TASKS:

PLC-01: Process module catalog
- process_module_catalog table: module_id (globally unique), version (semver), owning_definition_id, interface_schema, exportable, status (DRAFT|ACTIVE|DEPRECATED)
- process_module_catalog_share table: module_id,granted_to_tenant_id, granted_by, granted_at
- module_ref resolution: highest ACTIVE version satisfying version_constraint visible to tenant
- SUB_PROCESS with BOTH child_definition_id AND module_ref -> HTTP 422 SubProcessHasBothChildDefAndModuleRef
- API: GET /api/v1/process-modules, POST /api/v1/process-modules, GET /api/v1/process-modules/{module_id}/versions/{version}, POST /api/v1/process-modules/{module_id}/publish

PLC-02: Catalog entry publication requires declared interface
- publishModule: DRAFT -> ACTIVE gate: SPC-01 interface must be declared
- Missing interface -> HTTP 422
- Already-ACTIVE -> HTTP 409 ModuleAlreadyActive

PLC-03: Cross-version compatibility check
- On publish, compare new interface vs predecessor ACTIVE version
- Breaking changes (optional->required input, removed required output) -> COMPATIBILITY_WARNING in response
- First ACTIVE version (no predecessor) -> null, no warning

PLC-04: Cross-tenant distribution
- grantModuleVisibility(module_id, tenant_id) -> process_module_catalog_share row + audit_log event MODULE_SHARE_GRANTED
- revokeModuleVisibility(module_id, tenant_id) -> DELETE share row + audit_log event MODULE_SHARE_REVOKED
- module_ref resolution checks visibility (no info leak)

Run: zig build migrate
Run: zig build test (unit tests)

Return PASS when:
- zig build exits 0
- zig build test exits 0
- All design elements implemented
- Git add + git commit on feature/WF02-plc-batch-a-20260815
